objective: Test the production-shaped implementation of the already distribution-passing CW11.3 candidate by preparing its immutable training-corpus innovation bank once and measuring only per-sequence sampling, without changing any generated descriptor.

parents.cw11_3_1_corrected_timing_finding: Reference sampler rebuilds all eleven training-source innovation pools inside every generation call, dominating tiny folds.

candidate_identity.sampler: Same source-uniform and token-uniform empirical innovation draws, same RNG order, same seeds, same AR integration, same plus-or-minus-four clip.
candidate_identity.allowed_change: Move deterministic training-corpus standardization and token-pool construction into one immutable prepared bank outside the repeated sampling call.
candidate_identity.required_evidence: Prepared output must be NumPy array_equal to every saved CW11.3 empirical_innovation fold array.

performance_protocol.preparation: Fit AR and construct immutable source token pools once per corpus build; exclude this one-time setup from per-sequence sampling latency but report bank sizes.
performance_protocol.fold_statistic: median milliseconds per valid token per sample

promotion.pass_consequence: Proceed to exact compiled safety and owner visual gates.

claim_limit: Implementation and performance evaluation of the byte-identical CW11.3 candidate; no distribution result may be changed.
